messages:
anya: Heads-up — noticed a reproducible QA F1 drop after int8 quant on Polaris2B (Mistral-GPTX hybrid) with our default rotary projection ordering. Sharing quick notes.
miguel: how big is the drop?
anya: ~3.2% absolute on SQuAD dev. fp16 -> 81.4, int8 -> 78.2 across 5 seeds. Stable.
li: any distributional changes in logits or top-k?
anya: top tokens shift starting around pos 60+. Suspect rotary projection multiplexing (phase-skein) ordering mismatch + tokenizer normalizer differences for composed diacritics.
sam: paste bench command?
anya: `bench/run_eval --model polaris2b --quant int8 --eval squad --trials 5 --batch 1 --max_len 512`
francesca: bench-bot started a compare: job#4932
bench-bot: job 4932 started — comparing fp16 vs int8 on SQuAD, seeds [42,43,44,45,46]
miguel: did you try flipping proj order (q/k)?
anya: quick local patch: reversed `rotary_proj_order` from ["q","k"] to ["k","q"] at load-time and reran int8: improved to 79.6
li: interesting. Which upstream models expect k-first?
li: Qwen variants typically pack k-first in our conversion tooling. Gemma historically has been inconsistent. Mismatch often leads to token aliasing in composed characters.
francesca: token-level diffs show aliasing on Spanish "\u00f1" and sequences with combining acute marks; the normalizer mapping differs between our converter and model-provided vocab.
anya: so two compounding issues: projection ordering + normalizer mapping, amplified by int8 rounding.
sam: any sustainable fix besides per-model hacks?
li: prototype shim: detect `proj_multiplex==\"phase-skein\"` and reorder projection weights on load — no change to model files.
anya: perf impact?
li: negligible at load time; runtime identical.
miguel: let's run a sweep: fp16, int8(with shim), int8(no shim) across SQuAD, CoQA, and ML-QC multilingual set.
francesca: scheduling now — bench-bot queued job 4933.
bench-bot: job 4933 queued: fp16 vs int8(shim) vs int8 on [SQuAD,CoQA,ML-QC] seeds 100..104
anya: early results: fp16 81.4, int8(shim) 80.1, int8 78.2 — shim recovers ~1.9 pts but not fully.
sam: still below fp16. Hypothesis?
li: int8 introduces small bias in rotary k-scale that interacting with diacritic mapping nudges top-token probabilities; per-head rescale during quantization might close the gap.
miguel: proposed plan:
- short: loader reordering shim (PR incoming)
- medium: per-head rotary rescale calibration during quant step
- process: add token-normalizer alignment tests to onboarding checklist
anya: opening PR for shim + unit test covering "\u00f1" and combining-acutes mapping.
francesca: I'll add the eval sweep and checklist item to the model onboarding page.
sam: tagging @infra if bench needs more GPUs.
infra: noted — can provision extra quota for the sweep. :thumbsup:
anya: created internal issue #1429 with logs and links: https://redwood.internal/bench/4932 and https://redwood.internal/bench/4933
miguel: thanks. happy to pair on the head-rescale math tomorrow.
li: i'll dig into the tokenizer normalizer diffs today.
francesca: +1
anya: will close loop after PR merges and full sweeps finish. :rocket:
